name: three
comment: Not a real npm install -- this repo has no build step (see README) and vendors three.module.js directly under frontend/vendor/, resolved in the browser via index.html's <script type="importmap">. This shim exists only so `node --test` can resolve the same bare `import * as THREE from "three"` specifier frontend/*.js already uses, without changing any of those import lines or adding a real dependency. See tests/frontend/README.md.
